No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

Alauddin Khalji had the reservoir dug for his city of Siri. Firoz Shah Tughlaq later built a madrasa along its edge and his own tomb at the corner. The walk explains how the madrasa functioned and how to recognise Tughlaq architecture.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • The reservoir Alauddin Khalji had dug for his city of Siri
  • Firoz Shah Tughlaq's madrasa, hall by hall
  • Firoz Shah's tomb and the pavilions in the garden
  • How to recognise Tughlaq building: sloping walls, plain stone, little ornament

How the time is spent

  1. Reservoir panorama 25 min

    Alauddin Khalji water supply and medieval environment.

    You: draw watershed

  2. Madrasa approach 35 min

    Explain institutional plan and social function.

    You: map learning spaces

  3. Firoz Shah tomb 35 min

    Read tomb position within educational precinct.

    You: trace building phases

  4. Complex and landscape summary 25 min

    Contrast reservoir, tomb and current urban use.

    You: one-minute reflection

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Hauz Khas Complex using material evidence and a site map.
  • Understand a medieval reservoir, madrasa and tomb in one landscape.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.
